top_signals.title: Convicted Insider Trader Arrested in Dubai After Fleeing France
top_signals.summary: A trader convicted of insider dealing was arrested in Dubai on Wednesday after French authorities issued an arrest warrant to force him to serve a three year jail sentence, according to a government official.
